title: Pre-interview prep, the 2026 retelling
oneliner: Same four moves as his 2023 reel: company strategy, job-description match, mock interview with feedback, one project in full depth.
says: The four pre-interview tips again: study the company profile to understand its modernization or cloud migration journey and strategy; match the job description against your experience; run a mock interview with a close friend and fix what the feedback finds; and have one key innovative project you know thoroughly and can explain clearly.
explained: The script is nearly word-for-word the 2023 version - and that is the tell. Three years of interviewing candidates did not change his list, which means these four failures are still the ones costing people offers.

If you have already read reel #3, use this version as the checklist on the morning of the interview: Can I name their current strategy? Does my experience map to every line of the JD? Have I said my answers out loud to another human? Do I have one project I can defend to any depth?
takeaway: Duplicate advice, deliberate repetition: these four steps are his permanent interview checklist. Run them every time.
